Scribe для Windows 10/11: офлайн-распозн: Scribe for Windows 10/11: offline Vosk speech recognition, automatic punctuation and capitalization, voice commands, replacements, and hotkeys. Portable exe, free, MIT.
Диктовка с пунктуацией и голосовые коман: Dictation with punctuation and voice commands — speech is processed on your computer.
Портативная сборка ≈ 93 МБ: установка не: Portable build, ≈ 93 MB: no installation required. Vosk language models and punctuation models are downloaded separately.
Scribe сам расставляет знаки препинания: Scribe adds punctuation and restores capital letters in the final text — offline, on your computer. The feature is on by default; the switch is on the Models tab.
Компактная офлайн-модель расставляет точ: A compact offline model adds periods, commas, question and exclamation marks, colons, and ellipses, and restores capital letters.
Модель скачивается автоматически при пер: The model downloads automatically on first launch
Без модели остаются базовые правила: Basic rules still apply without the model
Базовые правила без модели: заглавная бу: Rule-based capitalization without a model: the first word of a sentence is capitalized after a period, question mark, or exclamation mark.
Свои знаки можно вставлять голосом через: You can insert your own marks by voice with replacements
Пауза — не конец предложения: на коротко: A pause is not the end of a sentence: Scribe does not add a period at a short hesitation or start a new sentence. Only a question mark, an exclamation mark, an ellipsis, Enter, or a spoken mark ends a sentence.
Не поддерживается с 1.3.0; последняя вер: Not supported since 1.3.0; the last supported version is 1.2.0
Для скачивания моделей Vosk и пунктуации: For downloading Vosk and punctuation models
Превращает компьютер в устройство с голо: Turns your computer into a voice-controlled device. Dictate text into any app, launch programs, and automate routine tasks — recognition works offline. Scribe adds punctuation and capital letters automatically.
Scribe распознаёт голос локально с помощ: Scribe recognizes speech locally with Vosk. Audio never goes to the cloud, and no account is needed — the internet is only required to download language and punctuation models.
Модели Vosk и пунктуации хранятся локаль: Vosk and punctuation models are stored locally
